title: Newmark Arranges $41 Million Sale and Acquisition Financing for Miro at the Parc, a 164-Unit Multifamily Community in Henderson, Nevada
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $41 million sale and $24.74 million acquisition financing for Miro at the Parc, a 164-unit multifamily…
body_markdown:
**September 16, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $41 million sale and $24.74 million acquisition financing for Miro at the Parc, a 164-unit multifamily community located at 1651 American Pacific Drive in Henderson, Nevada.


###


Newmark Vice Chairman[Jonathan Merhaut](https://www.nmrk.com/people/jonathan-merhaut) and Executive Managing Director[Curt Allsop](https://www.nmrk.com/people/curtis-r-allsop) arranged the sale on behalf of seller **,** Sares Regis Multifamily Investment Management. Newmark Vice Chairman[Lee Redmond](https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nmrk.com%2Fpeople%2Flee-redmond&data=05%7C02%7Cjonathan.merhaut%40nmrk.com%7C18c27d001b2b4e381cd808df0eb61445%7Cb4c85df22c4141239957f3c8a360f511%7C0%7C0%7C639245847343439403%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=aEaGgLx8lfnHT9WFS%2FQhKxmzA%2Bl1ABfl9YiaDEha1hc%3D&reserved=0) and Managing Director[Alec Newman](https://www.nmrk.com/people/alec-newman) arranged the financing on behalf of buyer, Authentic Capital Group.


Located in the Henderson submarket of Las Vegas, Miro at the Parc benefits from an A+ submarket location, proximity to major employment centers and large floorplans. The community is situated within Green Valley, one of Las Vegas’ most established residential corridors, where sustained population growth and limited housing inventory continue to support multifamily demand.


“We continue to have tremendous conviction in Las Vegas as an investment market, driven by strong in-migration, a diverse employment base and resilient renter demand,” said Allsop. “Miro at the Parc stands out for its location within Green Valley, spacious floorplans and long-term upside. These attributes, combined with the property’s quality and basis relative to replacement cost, generated significant interest from both investors and lenders.”


Southern Nevada continues to attract institutional and private capital as investors seek exposure to markets characterized by favorable migration patterns, economic diversification and strong multifamily fundamentals, according to[Newmark Research](https://www.nmrk.com/insights/market-report/las-vegas-market-reports) . Henderson, in particular, has emerged as a preferred destination for both residents and investors, benefiting from its high quality of life, expanding employment opportunities and access to the broader Las Vegas metropolitan area.


“The financing environment for quality multifamily assets remains competitive, particularly for well-located properties in high-growth markets,” added Redmond. “This transaction reflects lenders’ continued confidence in the Las Vegas market and the enduring appeal of strategically located multifamily investments.”
